'''Dennis K.J. Lin''' is a Taiwanese-American statistician who works in [[design of experiments]], [[quality assurance]], [[data mining]], and [[data science]].

==Education and early life==
He was born in Taiwan and obtained a bachelor's degree (in mathematics) in June 1981 from National Tsing-Hua University, ROC. He received a Ph.D. (in statistics) in December 1988 from the University of Wisconsin-Madison, with a minor in computer science.

==Career and research==
From 1995 to 2020, Lin worked as a statistician for Pennsylvania State University, and became a university distinguished professor.<ref>{{cite web |title=Dennis Lin named head of statistics department at Purdue University from 2020-2023, and JSM Deming Lecture
|url=https://imstat.org/2020/05/17/dennis-lin-named-head-of-statistics-department-at-purdue-university-and-jsm-deming-lecturer/ |website=imstat |accessdate=17 May 2020 |archive-date=3 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201003141740/https://imstat.org/2020/05/17/dennis-lin-named-head-of-statistics-department-at-purdue-university-and-jsm-deming-lecturer/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2020-05-17|title=Dennis Lin named head of statistics department at Purdue University, and JSM Deming Lecturer|url=https://imstat.org/2020/05/17/dennis-lin-named-head-of-statistics-department-at-purdue-university-and-jsm-deming-lecturer/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201003141725/https://imstat.org/2020/05/17/dennis-lin-named-head-of-statistics-department-at-purdue-university-and-jsm-deming-lecturer/|archive-date=2020-10-03|access-date=2020-10-03|website=|publisher=[[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]|language=en}}</ref> Since July 2020 - August 2023, he has been the head at the department of statistics at [[Purdue University]] and currently serves as a distinguished professor of statistics in Purdue.<ref name=":1" />

Lin published a total of over 200 papers in professional journals.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lin |first1=Dennis |title=Refereed Papers |url=http://www.personal.psu.edu/users/j/x/jxz203/lin/Lin_pub/. |website=personal.psu |accessdate=20 June 2018 |archive-date=12 January 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190112201331/http://personal.psu.edu/users/j/x/jxz203/lin/Lin_pub/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Lin is known for his contributions to the design of experiments, industrial statistics and Ghost Data.<ref>{{cite web |last1=JMPSoftware |first1=SAS |title=Hear about the careers of DOE greats Dennis K. J. Lin and Bradley Jones |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6hWoLSyNJVE |publisher=jmp |accessdate=5 June 2015 |archive-date=3 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201003141743/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6hWoLSyNJVE |url-status=live }}</ref>
